/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_250_2.

  Bodies: every road user is a car of half-length 2 m, half-width 1 m; the subject is track 1, the
  other vehicle v is track 2. Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.

  Map G1 (forbid, permit, idle, blind, branch_1..3; one scene per second): intersection X (10) is the
  square [-10, 10]²; highway H1 (20) runs north–south (x ∈ [-10, 10]), highway H2 (21) east–west
  (y ∈ [-10, 10]); X lies on both. Approach lanes entering X: c1 (11) northbound, x ∈ [0, 6],
  y ∈ [-30, -10], on H1 (the subject's); c2 (12) westbound, y ∈ [0, 6], x ∈ [10, 30], on H2 (v from
  the subject's right); c4 (13) eastbound, y ∈ [-6, 0], x ∈ [-30, -10], on H2 (v from the subject's
  left). A second intersection Y (30) north of X, y ∈ [50, 70], is entered by lane c3 (31) on H1,
  which a stop sign (1) governs: a device near X that controls no approach of X.
  Instants: k0 both vehicles are off the approach lanes; k1 both bodies are 0.5 m from X's edge on
  their lanes (the arrival); from k2 the scene of each witness.

  Map G2 (branch_4, branch_5; 50 ms steps around v's entry into X, so v's heading change since its
  entry is integrated): X as in G1, lying on H1 (south) and H2 (north); c1 northbound
  x ∈ [-1, 3.25], c2 southbound x ∈ [3.25, 8], y ∈ [10, 30]: opposed approaches from different
  highways, v (x = 4.5) on the right of the subject (x = 2).
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_250_2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_250_2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def carExtent : Q × Q × Q := (m 2, m 1, cm 75)

/-- A car with its yaw rate observed (deg/s). -/
def car (id : TrackId) (pos : Vec) (h : Vec) (speed : Q) (yaw : Q := Units.degrees 0) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin (Build.user id [.motorVehicle] pos h speed carExtent) (fun k => { k with yawRate := some yaw })

def noLeftTurn (users : List RoadUser) : List DeclaredIntent :=
  users.map fun u => { vehicle := u.track, target := 10, values := [("int.left_turn", false)] }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map G1
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def g1X : Structure := { Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10) with ways := some [20, 21] }
def g1H1 : Structure := Build.rect 20 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-60)) (m 10) (m 80)
def g1H2 : Structure := Build.rect 21 .highway (m (-60)) (m (-10)) (m 60) (m 10)
def g1C1 : Structure := { Build.lane 11 (box (m 0) (m (-30)) (m 6) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10) with ways := some [20] }
def g1C2 : Structure := { Build.lane 12 (box (m 10) (m 0) (m 30) (m 6)) Build.west (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }
def g1C4 : Structure := { Build.lane 13 (box (m (-30)) (m (-6)) (m (-10)) (m 0)) Build.east (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }
def g1Y : Structure := { Build.rect 30 .intersection (m (-10)) (m 50) (m 10) (m 70) with ways := some [20] }
def g1C3 : Structure := { Build.lane 31 (box (m 0) (m 10) (m 6) (m 50)) Build.north (enters := some 30) with ways := some [20] }

def g1Structures : List Structure := [g1X, g1H1, g1H2, g1C1, g1C2, g1C4, g1Y, g1C3]

def stopAtY : Device := Build.sign 1 .stopSign [31]
def yieldOnC1 : Device := Build.sign 2 .yieldSign [11]

def g1Scene (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (devs : List Device := [stopAtY]) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users g1Structures devs (intents := noLeftTurn users)

/-- The subject northbound on c1 (x = 3). -/
def sAt (y : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 1 (m 3, y) Build.north speed
/-- v westbound on c2 / through X (y = 3). -/
def vWest (x : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 2 (x, m 3) Build.west speed

/-- `forbid` (violated): Uncontrolled X. The subject on c1 and v on c2 (on another highway) arrive within p.same_time_arrival_window of each other; v lies to the subject's right (rel.bearing). The subject proceeds with kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance and its closest approach to v lies within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance.
    k1 both arrive at once (v to the right); k2 both bodies wholly inside X, the subject at 5 m/s
    north at (3, -3), v at 2 m/s west at (6, 3): closest approach after about 1.2 s at about 0.6 m. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 6) (Units.metresPerSecond 2)]

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same arrivals; the subject comes to rest at X's edge until v has crossed, then proceeds.
    k1–k3 the subject at rest at the edge while v crosses X; k4 v has left X westward, the subject
    proceeds; k5 the subject inside X. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 6 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 2 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (m 0) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 3 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (m (-8)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 4 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m (-20)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m 5) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m (-32)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): A dev.yield_sign governs c1: X is controlled. (The forbid motion.) -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 6) (Units.metresPerSecond 2)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]

/-- `blind` (unknown): Uncontrolled X; simultaneous arrivals from different highways; the subject proceeds in conflict with v; rel.bearing is absent, so which vehicle is on the right is unknown.
    k2 the subject inside X at 5 m/s, v still at its edge of X moving west at 5 m/s: closest
    approach after about 1.6 s at about 2.5 m. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- v eastbound on c4 / through X. -/
def vEast (pos : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 2 pos Build.east speed

/-- `branch_1` (compliant): Simultaneous arrivals; v lies to the subject's left; the subject proceeds first in conflict with v: no vehicle on its right is owed the right-of-way.
    v arrives on c4 from the west; k2 the subject at (3, -3) at 5 m/s, v at (-3, 1) at 5 m/s east:
    closest approach after 1 s at about 1.4 m. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vEast (m (-40), m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vEast (cm (-1250), m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vEast (m (-3), m 1) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): v on the subject's right arrives several times p.same_time_arrival_window after the subject; the subject proceeds: not approximately the same time.
    The subject arrives at k1 and waits at the edge; v arrives at k7 (6 s later); k8 the subject
    proceeds in conflict with v as in forbid. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 9 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let vx : Q := match k with
      | 0 => m 60 | 1 => m 55 | 2 => m 48 | 3 => m 41 | 4 => m 34 | 5 => m 27 | 6 => m 20 | 7 => cm 1250 | _ => m 6
    let s : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | 8 => sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | _ => sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    g1Scene t [s, vWest vx (if k == 8 then Units.metresPerSecond 2 else Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The subject arrives at uncontrolled X with no other road user in the scene. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map G2: opposed approaches from different highways
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def g2X : Structure := { Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10) with ways := some [20, 21] }
def g2H1 : Structure := Build.rect 20 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-60)) (m 10) (m 10)
def g2H2 : Structure := Build.rect 21 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 60)
def g2C1 : Structure := { Build.lane 11 (box (m (-1)) (m (-30)) (cm 325) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10) with ways := some [20] }
def g2C2 : Structure := { Build.lane 12 (box (cm 325) (m 10) (m 8) (m 30)) Build.south (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }

def g2Scene (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users [g2X, g2H1, g2H2, g2C1, g2C2] [] (intents := noLeftTurn users)

/-- The subject northbound on c1 (x = 2). -/
def s2 (y : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 1 (m 2, y) Build.north speed
/-- v southbound on c2 (x = 4.5), with its heading and yaw rate. -/
def v2 (pos : Vec) (h : Vec) (speed : Q) (yaw : Q := Units.degrees 0) : RoadUser := car 2 pos h speed yaw

/-- A trace over the listed instants (ms). -/
def atInstants (ts : List Timestamp) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range ts.length).map fun k => f k (ts.getD k 0)

/-- `branch_4` (violated): opposed approaches from different highways, v on the subject's right,
    neither vehicle intends or makes a left turn (v enters X straight, yaw rate zero): the pair is
    not excepted, and the subject proceeds in conflict with v.
    1000 ms both arrive; 1050 v enters X; 1100 the subject at (2, -6) at 5 m/s north, v at (4.5, 4)
    at 5 m/s south: closest approach after 1 s at 2.5 m. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  atInstants [0, 1000, 1050, 1100] fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g2Scene t [s2 (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, m 40) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | 1 => g2Scene t [s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, cm 1250) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | 2 => g2Scene t [s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, cm 750) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g2Scene t [s2 (m (-6)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), v2 (cm 450, m 4) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- v's heading after turning left by 15°, 30°, 45°, 60° from south (toward east). -/
def rot15 : Vec := (Units.ratio 2588 10000, Units.ratio (-9659) 10000)
def rot30 : Vec := (Units.ratio 5000 10000, Units.ratio (-8660) 10000)
def rot45 : Vec := (Units.ratio 7071 10000, Units.ratio (-7071) 10000)
def rot60 : Vec := (Units.ratio 8660 10000, Units.ratio (-5000) 10000)

/-- `branch_5` (compliant): opposed approaches from different highways, v on the subject's right; v
    is making a left turn: the subject waits at the edge while v enters X (3550 ms, more than the
    window after the arrivals at 1000 ms) and turns left at 300 deg/s for four 50 ms steps (60°);
    at 3800 ms, v at rest at (4, 3), the subject proceeds at 5 m/s from (2, -6) in conflict with it
    (closest approach after 1.8 s at 2 m): the pair is excepted. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace :=
  atInstants [0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 3500, 3550, 3600, 3650, 3700, 3750, 3800] fun k t =>
    let s : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => s2 (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 10 => s2 (m (-6)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | _ => s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    let v : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => v2 (cm 450, m 40) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 => v2 (cm 450, cm 1250) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 5 => v2 (cm 450, cm 750) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 2)
      | 6 => v2 (cm 440, cm 650) rot15 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 7 => v2 (cm 430, cm 550) rot30 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 8 => v2 (cm 420, cm 450) rot45 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 9 => v2 (cm 400, cm 300) rot60 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | _ => v2 (cm 400, cm 300) rot60 (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    g2Scene t [s, v]

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_250_2"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["rel.bearing"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .compliant ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_250_2

let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/
def regionsOfKind (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k == some true)).map (·.id)
/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

def rel_occupies (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  if s.occupancyObserved.contains x then some (s.occupies.contains (x, r)) else none
/-- Every region the road user occupies, when its occupancy was observed. -/
def rel_occupies_regions (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List RegionId) :=
  if s.occupancyObserved.contains x then some ((s.occupies.filter (·.1 == x)).map (·.2)) else none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Control devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Whether a device is of a kind: unknown where the source cannot tell that kind. -/
def devKind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.device d).bind fun dv => if dv.unobservedKinds.contains k then none else some (dv.kind == k)

def dev_traffic_signal (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .trafficSignal
def dev_traffic_signal_indications (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option (List SignalIndication) := (s.device d).bind (·.indications)
def dev_traffic_signal_shows (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) (i : SignalIndication) : Option Bool :=
  (dev_traffic_signal_indications s d).map (·.contains i)

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_250_2.

  Bodies: every road user is a car of half-length 2 m, half-width 1 m; the subject is track 1, the
  other vehicle v is track 2. Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.

  Map G1 (forbid, permit, idle, blind, branch_1..3; one scene per second): intersection X (10) is the
  square [-10, 10]²; highway H1 (20) runs north–south (x ∈ [-10, 10]), highway H2 (21) east–west
  (y ∈ [-10, 10]); X lies on both. Approach lanes entering X: c1 (11) northbound, x ∈ [0, 6],
  y ∈ [-30, -10], on H1 (the subject's); c2 (12) westbound, y ∈ [0, 6], x ∈ [10, 30], on H2 (v from
  the subject's right); c4 (13) eastbound, y ∈ [-6, 0], x ∈ [-30, -10], on H2 (v from the subject's
  left). A second intersection Y (30) north of X, y ∈ [50, 70], is entered by lane c3 (31) on H1,
  which a stop sign (1) governs: a device near X that controls no approach of X.
  Instants: k0 both vehicles are off the approach lanes; k1 both bodies are 0.5 m from X's edge on
  their lanes (the arrival); from k2 the scene of each witness.

  Map G2 (branch_4, branch_5; 50 ms steps around v's entry into X, so v's heading change since its
  entry is integrated): X as in G1, lying on H1 (south) and H2 (north); c1 northbound
  x ∈ [-1, 3.25], c2 southbound x ∈ [3.25, 8], y ∈ [10, 30]: opposed approaches from different
  highways, v (x = 4.5) on the right of the subject (x = 2).
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_250_2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_250_2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def box (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : List Vec := [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]

def carExtent : Q × Q × Q := (m 2, m 1, cm 75)

/-- A car with its yaw rate observed (deg/s). -/
def car (id : TrackId) (pos : Vec) (h : Vec) (speed : Q) (yaw : Q := Units.degrees 0) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin (Build.user id [.motorVehicle] pos h speed carExtent) (fun k => { k with yawRate := some yaw })

def noLeftTurn (users : List RoadUser) : List DeclaredIntent :=
  users.map fun u => { vehicle := u.track, target := 10, values := [("int.left_turn", false)] }

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map G1
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def g1X : Structure := { Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10) with ways := some [20, 21] }
def g1H1 : Structure := Build.rect 20 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-60)) (m 10) (m 80)
def g1H2 : Structure := Build.rect 21 .highway (m (-60)) (m (-10)) (m 60) (m 10)
def g1C1 : Structure := { Build.lane 11 (box (m 0) (m (-30)) (m 6) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10) with ways := some [20] }
def g1C2 : Structure := { Build.lane 12 (box (m 10) (m 0) (m 30) (m 6)) Build.west (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }
def g1C4 : Structure := { Build.lane 13 (box (m (-30)) (m (-6)) (m (-10)) (m 0)) Build.east (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }
def g1Y : Structure := { Build.rect 30 .intersection (m (-10)) (m 50) (m 10) (m 70) with ways := some [20] }
def g1C3 : Structure := { Build.lane 31 (box (m 0) (m 10) (m 6) (m 50)) Build.north (enters := some 30) with ways := some [20] }

def g1Structures : List Structure := [g1X, g1H1, g1H2, g1C1, g1C2, g1C4, g1Y, g1C3]

def stopAtY : Device := Build.sign 1 .stopSign [31]
def yieldOnC1 : Device := Build.sign 2 .yieldSign [11]

def g1Scene (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (devs : List Device := [stopAtY]) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users g1Structures devs (intents := noLeftTurn users)

/-- The subject northbound on c1 (x = 3). -/
def sAt (y : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 1 (m 3, y) Build.north speed
/-- v westbound on c2 / through X (y = 3). -/
def vWest (x : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 2 (x, m 3) Build.west speed

/-- `forbid` (violated): Uncontrolled X. The subject on c1 and v on c2 (on another highway) arrive within p.same_time_arrival_window of each other; v lies to the subject's right (rel.bearing). The subject proceeds with kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance and its closest approach to v lies within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance.
    k1 both arrive at once (v to the right); k2 both bodies wholly inside X, the subject at 5 m/s
    north at (3, -3), v at 2 m/s west at (6, 3): closest approach after about 1.2 s at about 0.6 m. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 6) (Units.metresPerSecond 2)]

/-- `permit` (compliant): Same arrivals; the subject comes to rest at X's edge until v has crossed, then proceeds.
    k1–k3 the subject at rest at the edge while v crosses X; k4 v has left X westward, the subject
    proceeds; k5 the subject inside X. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 6 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 2 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (m 0) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 3 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (m (-8)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 4 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m (-20)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m 5) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m (-32)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): A dev.yield_sign governs c1: X is controlled. (The forbid motion.) -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 6) (Units.metresPerSecond 2)] [stopAtY, yieldOnC1]

/-- `blind` (unknown): Uncontrolled X; simultaneous arrivals from different highways; the subject proceeds in conflict with v; rel.bearing is absent, so which vehicle is on the right is unknown.
    k2 the subject inside X at 5 m/s, v still at its edge of X moving west at 5 m/s: closest
    approach after about 1.6 s at about 2.5 m. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (m 40) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vWest (cm 1250) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- v eastbound on c4 / through X. -/
def vEast (pos : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 2 pos Build.east speed

/-- `branch_1` (compliant): Simultaneous arrivals; v lies to the subject's left; the subject proceeds first in conflict with v: no vehicle on its right is owed the right-of-way.
    v arrives on c4 from the west; k2 the subject at (3, -3) at 5 m/s, v at (-3, 1) at 5 m/s east:
    closest approach after 1 s at about 1.4 m. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vEast (m (-40), m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), vEast (cm (-1250), m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), vEast (m (-3), m 1) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `branch_2` (compliant): v on the subject's right arrives several times p.same_time_arrival_window after the subject; the subject proceeds: not approximately the same time.
    The subject arrives at k1 and waits at the edge; v arrives at k7 (6 s later); k8 the subject
    proceeds in conflict with v as in forbid. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 9 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    let vx : Q := match k with
      | 0 => m 60 | 1 => m 55 | 2 => m 48 | 3 => m 41 | 4 => m 34 | 5 => m 27 | 6 => m 20 | 7 => cm 1250 | _ => m 6
    let s : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | 8 => sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | _ => sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    g1Scene t [s, vWest vx (if k == 8 then Units.metresPerSecond 2 else Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The subject arrives at uncontrolled X with no other road user in the scene. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 3 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | 1 => g1Scene t [sAt (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g1Scene t [sAt (m (-3)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map G2: opposed approaches from different highways
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def g2X : Structure := { Build.rect 10 .intersection (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 10) with ways := some [20, 21] }
def g2H1 : Structure := Build.rect 20 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-60)) (m 10) (m 10)
def g2H2 : Structure := Build.rect 21 .highway (m (-10)) (m (-10)) (m 10) (m 60)
def g2C1 : Structure := { Build.lane 11 (box (m (-1)) (m (-30)) (cm 325) (m (-10))) Build.north (enters := some 10) with ways := some [20] }
def g2C2 : Structure := { Build.lane 12 (box (cm 325) (m 10) (m 8) (m 30)) Build.south (enters := some 10) with ways := some [21] }

def g2Scene (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users [g2X, g2H1, g2H2, g2C1, g2C2] [] (intents := noLeftTurn users)

/-- The subject northbound on c1 (x = 2). -/
def s2 (y : Q) (speed : Q) : RoadUser := car 1 (m 2, y) Build.north speed
/-- v southbound on c2 (x = 4.5), with its heading and yaw rate. -/
def v2 (pos : Vec) (h : Vec) (speed : Q) (yaw : Q := Units.degrees 0) : RoadUser := car 2 pos h speed yaw

/-- A trace over the listed instants (ms). -/
def atInstants (ts : List Timestamp) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range ts.length).map fun k => f k (ts.getD k 0)

/-- `branch_4` (violated): opposed approaches from different highways, v on the subject's right,
    neither vehicle intends or makes a left turn (v enters X straight, yaw rate zero): the pair is
    not excepted, and the subject proceeds in conflict with v.
    1000 ms both arrive; 1050 v enters X; 1100 the subject at (2, -6) at 5 m/s north, v at (4.5, 4)
    at 5 m/s south: closest approach after 1 s at 2.5 m. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  atInstants [0, 1000, 1050, 1100] fun k t =>
    match k with
    | 0 => g2Scene t [s2 (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, m 40) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | 1 => g2Scene t [s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, cm 1250) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)]
    | 2 => g2Scene t [s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0), v2 (cm 450, cm 750) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]
    | _ => g2Scene t [s2 (m (-6)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5), v2 (cm 450, m 4) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 5)]

/-- v's heading after turning left by 15°, 30°, 45°, 60° from south (toward east). -/
def rot15 : Vec := (Units.ratio 2588 10000, Units.ratio (-9659) 10000)
def rot30 : Vec := (Units.ratio 5000 10000, Units.ratio (-8660) 10000)
def rot45 : Vec := (Units.ratio 7071 10000, Units.ratio (-7071) 10000)
def rot60 : Vec := (Units.ratio 8660 10000, Units.ratio (-5000) 10000)

/-- `branch_5` (compliant): opposed approaches from different highways, v on the subject's right; v
    is making a left turn: the subject waits at the edge while v enters X (3550 ms, more than the
    window after the arrivals at 1000 ms) and turns left at 300 deg/s for four 50 ms steps (60°);
    at 3800 ms, v at rest at (4, 3), the subject proceeds at 5 m/s from (2, -6) in conflict with it
    (closest approach after 1.8 s at 2 m): the pair is excepted. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace :=
  atInstants [0, 1000, 2000, 3000, 3500, 3550, 3600, 3650, 3700, 3750, 3800] fun k t =>
    let s : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => s2 (m (-40)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 10 => s2 (m (-6)) (Units.metresPerSecond 5)
      | _ => s2 (cm (-1250)) (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    let v : RoadUser := match k with
      | 0 => v2 (cm 450, m 40) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 => v2 (cm 450, cm 1250) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
      | 5 => v2 (cm 450, cm 750) Build.south (Units.metresPerSecond 2)
      | 6 => v2 (cm 440, cm 650) rot15 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 7 => v2 (cm 430, cm 550) rot30 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 8 => v2 (cm 420, cm 450) rot45 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | 9 => v2 (cm 400, cm 300) rot60 (Units.metresPerSecond 2) (Units.degrees 300)
      | _ => v2 (cm 400, cm 300) rot60 (Units.metresPerSecond 0)
    g2Scene t [s, v]

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_250_2"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("subject", 1)]
    expected := expected
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace .violated ["rel.bearing"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .compliant ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_250_2

# NRS_484B_250_2 — task result

## Final verdict

`WITNESS_FAIL` — `blind: expected unknown, got violated; the manifest masks rel.bearing`.

**The node is wrong:** the planned `blind` scenario can't be built. Details are below.

## Gate runs (3 of 6 used)

1. **Baseline** (the harness skeleton, before any edit): `UNUSED_CLAIM` (dev_governs, dev_stop_sign, dev_traffic_signal, dev_yield_sign, …), which is expected from the placeholders.
   - My mistake: I appended an `ls` of the Core directory to this command. Later I also ran one `grep` and one `wc` outside the gate. All three only read Core files. They changed nothing.
2. **After writing the rule and nine witnesses** (the seven planned plus `branch_4` and `branch_5`): `WITNESS_FAIL`. Only `blind` failed. It came out `violated` instead of `unknown`, and every other witness reached its planned verdict.
3. **Diagnostic run**, with `blind` temporarily set to expect `violated`, to see whether the later checks (adequacy and the rest) pass: `WITNESS_FAIL: the witness declares violated, the plan requires unknown`.
   - The gate checks the planned verdict first, so nothing can get past `blind`.
   - I restored the planned expectation (`unknown`, masking `rel.bearing`) afterwards.

## Why the node is wrong (scenario `blind`, span e/h, masked atom `rel.bearing`)

The plan's `blind` witness masks only `rel.bearing` and expects `unknown` "because which vehicle is on the right is unknown". Under Core that can't happen:

- `rel_bearing` (`Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean`, `rel_bearing` / `relFrame`) uses a measured bearing when the source supplies one. Otherwise it computes the bearing from `kin.position` of both road users and `kin.heading` of the subject.
- Masking `rel.bearing` (`Core/Runtime/Manifest.lean`, `Mask.relation`) only drops a measured value. The Mask docstring says: "The computed relations are blanked through the kinematics they would be computed from only when the source lacks those too."
- With positions and headings observed, the bearing is still computed and decided. So the masked trace gives the same verdict as `forbid`: `violated`.
- Removing the kinematics from the trace instead doesn't work either:
  - Without the subject's heading there is no footprint.
  - A track whose occupancy is observed must have a footprint (TraceLint), and dropping the subject from `occupancyObserved` makes `rel.occupies` unknown.
  - Without v's position, v's distance to X is unknown.
  - Either way the witness becomes unknown for unmasked atoms (`rel_occupies`, `st_region_geometry_distance`), which the gate rejects as stray reasons.

**What the plan must change:** mask an atom that Core reads straight from a field and never recomputes. `kin.speed` works: the subject proceeding above `p.halt_speed_tolerance` becomes unknown, so the duty is unknown, and nothing else changes. I checked this against this rule and the `blind` trace in the witness file:

- The duty `¬(speed > halt ∧ approach ∧ distance < clearance)` becomes unknown, with `absentAtom kin_speed` as the only reason.
- The other bindings stay decided, including the intersection itself acting as a candidate carrier.

`st.on_way` would **not** work on this geometry. With it masked, the pairing where the intersection stands in as c1 also goes unknown, through `st_lane_enters` on the intersection, which is a stray reason.

More generally, no computed `rel.*` relation (`rel.bearing`, `rel.contact`, `rel.centre_distance`, …) should be a `blind` mask when the trace carries full kinematics.

## How the rule is written

Rule file: `library/TrafficSpec/Rules/NRS_484B/NRS_484B_250_2.lean`. Its header records the reading span by span.

- **Class:** `ru_aggregate(subject, DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle)`.
- **Arrival (b):** `st_lane_enters(c, X) ∧ since (occ(x, c) ∨ occ(x, X)) (rises (occ(x, c) ∧ st_region_geometry_distance(x, X) ≤ p.stop_point_tolerance))`. X ranges over intersections and c over travel regions.
- **Applicability:** some intersection X where the subject has arrived on some c1, and X is not controlled; and `¬ruleApplies` for `NRS_484B_250_4_o1` and `NRS_484B_250_4_o2` (subject ↦ subject).
- **Control (j):** one device quantifier for each of traffic_signal, stop_sign and yield_sign. The device governs X, or governs a travel region c with `st_lane_enters(c, X)`.
- **Obligation:** X and c1 are selected again exactly as in the applicability, including "not controlled" (rule 3c). Then the duty runs for every other user v and every carrier c2 where:
  - v is a member of the aggregate and arrived on c2 in the same way;
  - some highway h has `st_on_way(c2, h)` and not `st_on_way(c1, h)`;
  - `|sinceRise(subject arrival) − sinceRise(v arrival)| ≤ p.same_time_arrival_window`;
  - v is on the subject's right at the later of the two arrivals. This is written as the bearing at the latest rise of either arrival: `since (¬(rises A_s ∨ rises A_v)) ((rises A_s ∨ rises A_v) ∧ rel_bearing(subject, v, right))`;
  - the pair is not excepted. A pair is excepted when the dot product of the c1 and c2 lane directions is below −p.oncoming_heading_cos, and one of these holds:
    - the subject or v declares `int.left_turn` at X;
    - v's `headingSince` since its entry into X (step `p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph`) is in [p.turn_heading_min, p.u_turn_heading_min).

  The duty itself: `¬rel_contact` and `¬(kin_speed > p.halt_speed_tolerance ∧ prim_closest_approach_within ∧ prim_closest_approach_distance < p.conflict_centre_clearance)`.
- **Choices left open:** none were needed beyond the record, so `narrowings` is empty. One choice I did make: I wrote "at the later of the two arrivals" as "at the latest rise of either arrival". Each arrival is the latest rise of its own formula, so this is the same instant and needs no window.

## Witnesses

Witness file: `library/TrafficSpecWitness/NRS_484B/NRS_484B_250_2.lean`.

- The seven planned witnesses use map G1:
  - forbid
  - permit
  - idle (a yield sign governs c1)
  - blind
  - branch_1 (v from the left)
  - branch_2 (v arrives 6 s later)
  - branch_3 (subject alone)
- `branch_4` (violated) and `branch_5` (compliant) are added and use map G2. They exercise the exception for opposed approaches: lane directions, intents and v's heading change. Around v's entry into X they use 50 ms steps, so `headingSince` is decided.
- G1 also has a stop sign that governs an approach to a different intersection Y. This exercises the governs/enters leaves of the control exception.
- Every witness except `blind` reached its planned verdict in run 2. Adequacy (`VACUOUS`) was never reached, because the gate stops at the `blind` failure.

## Why I finished

The node's `blind` scenario can't be built under Core's semantics (computed relations ignore the mask), and a planned verdict isn't mine to change. The rest of the rule and the witnesses are in place. The plan agent needs to re-plan `blind` with a directly read atom such as `kin.speed`. The existing `blindTrace` should then pass as written, with only the manifest's masked id changed.

With those observed, the bearing is still known, so the `blind` trace comes out `violated`, like `forbid`. Taking the positions or heading out of the trace doesn't help either: other atoms (occupancy, distance to the intersection) become unknown, and the gate rejects those as unmasked reasons.

**What the plan should change.** Mask an atom Core reads directly and never recomputes. `kin.speed` should work: the subject "proceeding" becomes unknown and nothing else changes. Then the existing `blind` trace should pass with only the mask changed. I checked this by reading the evaluator, not with a gate run. `st.on_way` would not work on this map: it also leaves the case where the intersection itself stands in as the subject's carrier unknown, for an unmasked reason. In general, no computed relation (bearing, contact, centre distance) can be a `blind` mask on a trace with full kinematics.
